usageNotes: Call this before creating or updating an ACME account to discover the available directory endpoints (e.g., Let's Encrypt production and staging). No parameters or special privileges are required — any authenticated user or API token can call it. Use the returned 'name' and 'url' fields when referencing a directory in account or plugin configuration.

examples.summary: List all known ACME directory endpoints

tips: The list is built into PDM and reflects well-known public ACME directories (e.g., Let's Encrypt v2 production and staging); it is not user-configurable.
Use the staging directory (if listed) for testing certificate workflows before switching to production to avoid Let's Encrypt rate limits.
The 'url' value from this response is the canonical endpoint to supply when referencing an ACME directory in plugin or account configurations.
